steps: Purée the Carrot (cooked) with 60 ml of the Coconut milk in a blender until completely smooth.
Pour the remaining Coconut milk into a large bowl or jug.
Whisk in the Chia seeds, Maple syrup, Cinnamon, and Vanilla extract until well combined.
Stir in the carrot purée until the mixture is evenly orange and smooth.
Divide the mixture among 4 small glasses or jars, about 150 ml each.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight, until fully set and pudding-like.
Stir each cup gently before serving to loosen any settled chia seeds.
Store covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; do not freeze.
